Card Q&A.a: It refers to a card that contains the specified text or icon in its name, traits, effects, inherited effects, (Rule), digivolution requirements, DNA digivolution, DigiXros requirements, burst digivolve, App Fusion, Link, or Assembly requirements. For example, a card with [Knightmon] in its text would include cards with the name [DarkKnightmon] and cards with the text [Knightmon] in their effects.
Card Q&A.q: What does a card with "X in its text" refer to?

Can this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect place this card in the digivolution cards of a Digimon with [Seadramon] in its text, then return 1 of my opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as 1 of my other Digimon with [Seadramon] in its text to the bottom of the deck?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing this Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of any of your other Digimon with [Seadramon] in their texts, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as high or lower a level as 1 of your Digimon with [Seadramon] in its text to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon with [Seadramon] in its text would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by trashing 2 same-level cards in its digivolution cards, it doesn't leave.
